app.title: Pump coach
banner.simulated: Simulated demo data. Not a real farm.
plan.paused: No minutes yet: first a question
plan.unmet: {litres} L short under today's water cap
plan.voice_fallback: Voice: device text-to-speech (fallback, not recorded clips)
reason.at_or_above_trigger: The crop has used {deficit} mm of water since the soil was last full. Watering starts at {trigger} mm, so put it back.
reason.assumed_due: Declared due by the demo scenario ({deficit} mm used).
reason.below_trigger: The soil still holds enough water: {deficit} mm used, watering starts at {trigger} mm.
reason.missing_input: Something essential is unknown, so no minutes are shown.
reason.contradiction: The soil check and the water count disagree.
q.ask_area: How big is the plot? Walk the boundary with the phone.
q.ask_bucket_test: Time how long the pump takes to fill a 20-litre bucket.
q.ask_method: How do you water: furrows, sprinkler or drip?
q.ask_crop_stage: What is growing, and how old is it?
q.ask_soil_test: Do the ribbon test: squeeze moist soil into a ribbon.
q.ask_moisture_check: Dig a handful of soil at root depth and check how wet it is.
q.ask_rain_since: How much rain fell since {since}? Read the water depth in your container, in mm.
q.ask_second_check: The soil check and the water count disagree. Please check the soil once more.
q.escalate_extension_officer: The checks keep disagreeing. Please ask your extension officer to look at the plot.
rain.label: Rain since {since} (mm)
rain.hint: Any straight-sided container left in the open: the water depth is the rainfall.
w.salty_water: Water may be salty: get a water test and extension advice. The coach will not add extra water on its own.
w.clay_short_sets: Clay soil: water in shorter, more frequent sets and never flood a waterlogged field.
w.steep_slope_furrow: Steep plot: furrows can wash soil away. Run them along the contour.
w.fertilizer_logged: Fertilizer logged. It does not change today's numbers yet.
w.water_scarce_no_expansion: Water is shared and scarce: savings mean less fuel and money, not more land.
w.crop_proxy_parameters: Crop numbers borrowed from {proxy_for}: check with your extension officer.
plot.soil_awc: Water the soil can hold (mm per m)
plot.deficit: Water used since soil was full (simulated)
log.inputs: Inputs and where they came from
scenario.label: Demo scenario
